Each variant has a flawless price (the site calls it MSP) – what you get for a phone with no defects and all accessories, bill and warranty. Every condition defect has a fixed deduction, so:
quote = flawless price − Σ (deductions of the defects declared)

Checked against the site's own quote endpoint: single defects, random multi-defect combinations and 12 devices across brands matched exactly (36/36). Deductions only stop adding up when they exceed the flawless price; the site quotes such phones separately and prices here are floored at ₹0.
